resources.string: Save Your Recovery Codes
Recovery Codes
Reset Your Password
Change Password
Generate and save ten recovery codes before entering GoServe. You can use a saved code to recover your account without email.
Unused recovery codes: %1$d
Old codes cannot be displayed again. Generating new codes replaces every unused code from your previous set and may require you to sign in again.
Generate Recovery Codes
Generate New Recovery Codes
Recovery Code
These ten codes are shown only now. Each code can recover only your account, once.
Save them in a password manager or somewhere private. If you take a screenshot, protect it and check your photo and cloud backup settings. GoServe will not save or upload this screen for you.
I Have Saved My Codes
Enter your account email and one of your saved recovery codes. A code can be used only once.
Verify Recovery Code
Choose a new GoServe password. Verification lasts five minutes. After the change is confirmed, GoServe will sign you in.
Save New Password
Your password change is being checked. Check its status here; GoServe will not send another password change. Leaving this screen ends this app’s status check.
Check Status
Check Recovery Status
Sign In Again
Design preview cannot read or create recovery codes or change a password.
Enter a valid account email address.
Enter one of your saved recovery codes.
That code could not be verified. Check the account email and code, then try again.
Verification could not be confirmed. This code may already be used; another saved recovery code may be needed. Your password has not changed during this step.
This verification expired or is unavailable. Return to sign in and start again.
Sign in again before generating recovery codes. Use TIP Google or your current GoServe password.
Too many recovery attempts. Wait before trying again. Normal sign-in is still available.
The new code set could not be confirmed. Check recovery status before continuing. Lost codes cannot be displayed again; generate a new set after signing in again.
Recovery is unavailable for this session. Sign in again to continue.
GoServe could not complete this step. Check your connection and try again.
Your password change was confirmed, but sign-in could not be completed. Sign in with your new password.
The password change was not completed. Return to sign in and start recovery again.
If you have lost all your recovery codes, use your TIP Google account or current GoServe password to sign in. GoServe cannot bypass account verification.
Create Your Account
Create your student account with your verified @tip.edu.ph Google account.
After Google verification, review the Terms, complete your student details and save your recovery codes. You do not need another app.
Continue With TIP Google
